'''Kesivo''' was a shadowy benefactor who owned warriors involved in the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] games, among whom was [[Giant Flog]]. Kesivo [[Death/Legends|died]] in a tragic accident in [[the Cauldron]] arena on the planet [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] when Flog's boulder weapon crushed his viewing box.

==Biography==
===Owner of a demon===
[[File:AngryGiantFlog.jpg|280px|left|thumb|Giant Flog, a gladiator who belonged to Kesivo]]
During the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Kesivo was a hidden benefactor and owner of warriors involved in the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] games. Once, Kesivo purchased a new combatant known only as [[Giant Flog]] on a fruitful trading mission to the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]], though mystery veiled any other details.<ref name="DB" /> The opportunity to realize his violent potential came<ref name="CW">{{CW|6}}</ref> on the forsaken world of [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]], where brutal violence was an everyday reality, far from the laws of the Republic.<ref name="BS">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20031119.html|text=The Blood-sport of Rattatak}}</ref>

Few Rattatak gladiators enjoyed careers that spanned [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], let alone [[Standard year/Legends|years]], but the simple brute Giant Flog survived the bloody circuit for nearly two standard years and proved to be the most profitable fighter for Kesivo. Surrounding patrons knew almost nothing about Giant Flog or his mysterious owner. This caginess led to countless rumors among the other patrons, and such unbridled speculation only fed Giant Flog's reputation. Wild tales included stories that Flog was a [[Demon/Legends|demon]] summoned by occult means, while others claimed that he had been stitched together from the parts of dead gladiators. Though [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], Giant Flog obeyed only Kesivo.<ref name="DB" />

===Fateful day===
Shortly after the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Giant Flog ended up in the [[the Cauldron]] arena.<ref name="CW" /> It was the largest gladiatorial pit on Rattatak, filled with violent warriors, where war barons and generals sought out the best combatants who would win their wars.<ref name="DBR">{{DB|location|rattatak|Rattatak}}</ref> Therefore, Giant Flog, like many other gladiators,<ref name="CW" /> entered a deadly free-for-all battle,<ref name="EGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> but it was a rare gladiator indeed who could survive multiple fights there.<ref name="DBR" />

[[File:KesivoDeath.jpg|280px|right|thumb|The death of Kesivo]]
During one battle, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] attended a match in the Cauldron, hoping to find a new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] among the fighters. Soon, the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] entered the arena and, in a short time, defeated most of the remaining gladiators. Giant Flog was the last warrior left to face her. A strike from her paired [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] felled the titan and also severed the chain of the mace he wielded like a primitive weapon. The liberated chunk of stone soared through the air and crashed into the viewing box<ref name="CW" /> holding Kesivo and his companions. Giant Flog's benefactor was crushed to [[Death/Legends|death]] before he could witness the demise of his fighter.<ref name="DB" />

==Personality==
Little was known about this shadowy benefactor. Unlike other patrons, Kesivo was not prone to bragging; he was tight-lipped, and his only conversations concerned payment, wagering, and other transactions. This caginess<ref name="DB" /> led to countless rumors and unbridled speculation<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|I|339-340|Flog, Giant}}</ref> among the other patrons, which only fed the reputation of his most profitable combatant, [[Giant Flog]].<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kesivo<ref name="DB" /> first appeared as an unnamed background character in the [[Chapter 6 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|sixth chapter]]<ref name="CW" /> of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'', an animated television micro-series<ref name="Chapter Archive">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/microseries/chapter/archive.html|text=View ''Clone Wars'' Chapter Archive}}</ref> produced by [[Cartoon Network]] Studios<ref name="Volume One">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Volume One|''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' Volume One]]</ref> and originally aired on [[November 14]], [[2003]].<ref name="TV">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-clone-wars/chapter-vi-276612|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars - Season 1, Episode 6: Chapter VI}}</ref> The character was later given a name and short backstory in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for the character [[Giant Flog]] on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' website, [[StarWars.com]], in [[2003]].<ref name="DB" />
